name: FFS_QBI_CAR_CATEGORY
description: Stores an assignment of capacity categories to capacity areas.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Primary Key. Unique identifies relation between capacity area and capacity category.

columns.name: AREA_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to AREA_ID in FFS_QBI_CAPACITY_AREA.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key. Points to WORK_SKILL_ID in FFS_WORK_SKILL.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of this assignment. Interval of assignment includes this start date.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of this assignment. Interval of assignment includes this end date. NULL value means endless assignment.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
